subject: Issues with the get.real() function, multi session

messages.author: 31506034231fd9e5
messages.subject: Issues with the get.real() function, multi session
parts:
Hello everyone!

I am working with camera trap data in the oSCR package, and I have two sessions. I wrote an EDF containing information about both sessions (a single document) and separate TDFs, as stated in the package usage manual. Everything went well for most of the analysis, and it seems that R understands that I have two distinct sessions when I read the data.ss and data.sf objects, plot the maps, etc.

The issue is that after selecting the best model (D ~ 1 p0 ~ 1 sig ~ sex), when I use the get.real() function, I get the same density estimates for both sessions! This is quite frustrating because it works perfectly well when I have only one session in the analysis. I have tried writing the code in different ways several times, but I am having a lot of difficulty.

Can anyone help me? I have attached some relevant screenshots and my code.
Thank you sooo much :)

messages.author: 527d9b3ec7deff2d
messages.subject: Re: Issues with the get.real() function, multi session
parts:
Hi Maria, your top model assumed that density was constant (D~1) so the expected density should indeed be identical between the sessions.  You would need to fit session-specific model (D~session) for the expected values to differ.  You could still take this top model and generate realized density estimates using the predict.oSCR function:

pred <- predict.oSCR(guttulus_null_density)
d.factor <- 16
mean(pred$ssN[[1]]) * d.factor #make sure to multiply by d.factor
mean(pred$ssN[[2]]) * d.factor
